name: Barbarian audit: Unified Rage spell modifier reaches its target spells (#2567)
contract: Audit report #2567 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 801761 has no modifier for op 12
705212 op 12 flat +25 reaches 801761 (mask selects 1 Barbarian spell(s))
